name: Strana chudes Mnogolikogo Boga
source:
Our story tells of a guy who finds himself transported to Sovyonok. Unlike other isekai protagonists, this guy knows absolutely everything about Everlasting Summer and would not mind spending a shift or two in this PARADISE. Our protagonist, Maxim, is a typical hikikomori of modern times. He is unsociable and slightly rude. His only salvation in this mortal world is his computer, and his alter ego named Shin.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1444283219]Steam[/url]]
